description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating ONNX models and related protobuf data, including exporting models as test cases, loading test cases, and handling ONNX protobuf operations. It is part of the internal ONNX export utilities in the PyTorch project.

methods.name: str export_as_test_case( model_bytes: bytes, inputs_data, outputs_data, name: str, dir: str )
methods.description: Exports an ONNX model along with input and output data as a self-contained test case directory.

methods.name: tuple[bytes,Any,Any] load_test_case(dir: str)
methods.description: Loads a self-contained ONNX test case from a directory, returning the model bytes and associated input/output data.

methods.name: None export_data(data, value_info_proto, f: str)
methods.description: Exports data to ONNX protobuf format, writing to a specified file.

methods.name: None _export_file( model_bytes: bytes, f: io.BytesIO | str, export_map: Mapping[str, bytes], )
methods.description: Writes model bytes into a file or directory, primarily used internally for serialization.

methods.name: bytes _add_onnxscript_fn( model_bytes: bytes, custom_opsets: Mapping[str, int], )
methods.description: Inserts custom ONNX-script functions into a model proto based on specified custom opsets.

methods.name: _find_onnxscript_op( graph_proto, included_node_func: set[str], custom_opsets: Mapping[str, int], onnx_function_list: list, )
methods.description: Recursively traverses a graph proto to find and process ONNX functions/operators, especially for control flow nodes.
